text:
Tanvi Sharma: quick heads-up — bringing up flamingo-embed-v1.2 (contrastive-trained) on the multilingual holdout, ran int8 per-channel quant, seeing recall@10 drop ~4.8% vs fp16 :thinking_face:
Ashok Patel: can you paste the eval numbers and the eval command?
Tanvi Sharma: sure — small run (5k holdout)
```
# command
python eval_embeddings.py --model flamingo-v1.2 --quant perchannel --holdout multilingual --k 10 --calib 5000
\n# results
fp16: recall@10 = 0.781
int8-perchannel: recall@10 = 0.733
int8-pertensor: recall@10 = 0.759
silhouette (fp16) = 0.42
silhouette (int8-perchannel) = 0.36
```
Eli Gomez: hmm int8 pertensor better than perchannel — that's odd (usually perchannel >= pertensor) :eyes:
Marco Li: did you use the same mean-centering / L2 norm pipeline before storing vectors? small preproc mismatch can shift cosines
Tanvi Sharma: yes same pipeline: normalize=True, center=False. I tried with center=True quick — int8-perchannel recall went to 0.748 (still below fp16)
Ashok Patel: can you run calibration with a larger cal set (20k) and try symmetric vs asymmetric quant? also try 6-bit if supported
Tanvi Sharma: queued runs: 20k calib symmetric, 20k calib asymmetric, per-tensor 6bit (quant lib supports it). starting now. ci-bot: started job 2835008650
ci-bot: job 2835008650 finished — artifacts at s3://redwood-evals/flamingo-v1.2/int8/2835008650/
Tanvi Sharma: results (20k calib symmetric): recall@10 = 0.755, silhouette = 0.39
Eli Gomez: much better. suggests calibration noise was the issue. can you diff centroid shifts?
Tanvi Sharma: plotted centroid shifts — mean cosine between fp16 centroids and int8-perchannel centroids = 0.92 with small skew by lang (de-de, ja-jp worst)
Marco Li: language-specific tokenizer tokens might cause embedding offset — test language-wise normalization and per-lang calibration
Ashok Patel: also try post-quant euclidean rescale: compute scale s = std(fp16)/std(int8) per-dim and rescale int8 vectors before normalizing
Tanvi Sharma: adding that to the queue. plan: (1) per-lang calib (2) centroid rescale (3) try pertensor 6-bit and perchannel 6-bit (4) run full 100k holdout after smoke
Eli Gomez: annotate regression ticket? put links to eval artifacts + plots.
Tanvi Sharma: created ticket INF-7823 and added artifacts link + minimal repro snippet. snippet:
```
# repro apply rescale
v_int8 = load_vecs('int8.bin')
scale = load('scale.npy')
v_adj = (v_int8 * scale)
v_norm = v_adj / np.linalg.norm(v_adj, axis=1, keepdims=True)
```
Marco Li: if rescale helps, we should add auto-rescale to the onboarder as an optional post-quant transform
Ashok Patel: agree. also add a check in bringup: compare recall drop > 2% -> trigger per-lang calib and rescale suggestion in the dashboard
Tanvi Sharma: OK will PR a small change to the eval harness and add a note in the onboarding checklist. thanks y'all :rocket:
